C0024.title: Shanghai Police Dismantle Criminal Gang Using Automated Software to Scalp and Resell Medical Appointments
C0024.summary: The Minhang branch of the Shanghai Public Security Bureau dismantled a criminal gang involved in automated appointment scalping, hoarding, reselling, and patient referral services, arresting 10 suspects.
